guard: every structured command exits by one outcome table, an error code belongs to one outcome, and a failure envelope keeps its native cause and changed resources
why: A script reads a command's outcome from its exit code and its envelope, so a drift in the table, a code accepted under the wrong outcome, or a dropped cause or changed list misleads every caller. The suite imports the workspace package through its build, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.name: any code passes under any outcome
mutations.find: return allowed.includes(code) ? undefined : `outcome ${outcome} cannot carry error code ${code}`;
mutations.expectRed: a refusal cannot carry an operation code
mutations.cell: a refusal cannot carry an operation code

mutations.name: the native cause is dropped
mutations.expectRed: the native cause is kept beside the stable code
mutations.cell: the native cause is kept beside the stable code

mutations.name: a failure envelope drops what changed
a failure is recognized by instanceof
mutations.find: return typeof e === "object" && e !== null && (e as { [FAILURE_BRAND]?: unknown })[FAILURE_BRAND] === true;
mutations.expectRed: a branded failure from another module copy is recognized
mutations.cell: a branded failure from another module copy is recognized

mutations.name: an envelope line is not checked
mutations.expectRed: an ok envelope carrying an error is refused
mutations.cell: an ok envelope carrying an error is refused

mutations.name: a json output accepts a flag without -j
mutations.expectRed: a json flag without its -j short is refused
mutations.cell: a json flag without its -j short is refused
